CL-STA-1062 Targets Southeast Asian Governments and Critical Infrastructure
actor_profiles.notes: Threat Research (author: Unit 42). Chinese-speaking espionage cluster CL-STA-1062 targeting government and critical-infrastructure (energy) entities in Southeast Asia, active since at least March 2022, using a hybrid toolkit including the custom TinyRCT backdoor. New China-nexus cluster — NOT in scope_seeds.actors (corpus currently tracks Phantom Taurus, Stately Taurus, APT41 for China-nexus). P1 cluster profile with new TTPs (custom backdoor + espionage tradecraft). No draft stub created per the weekly-canvas guard: new actor/cluster + new malware family (TinyRCT) not yet in corpus -> routes to operator review. OPERATOR REVIEW: (1) add 'CL-STA-1062' and 'TinyRCT' to discovery-queries.json scope_seeds; (2) decide whether to author an espionage/custom-backdoor TTP.

New TTP angles: encryption-less double extortion, swatting as a physical-pressure technique (CL-CRI-1116 / BlackFile, now rebranded 'Redact'), TGR-CRI-1135 (TeamPCP) RaaS/EaaS partnerships + open-source Shai-Hulud release (May 13). cloud_identity.title: IAM Your Defense Against Cloud Threats
Cloud Threats on the Rise: Alert Trends Show Intensified Attacker Focus on IAM, Exfiltration
Responding to Cloud Incidents — 2025 IR Report
Novel Technique to Detect Cloud Threat Actor Operations
Can AI Attack the Cloud? Lessons From the Zealot Autonomous Multi-Agent System
The Global Namespace Risk: Universal Bucket Hijacking Technique for Cloud Data Exfiltration
cloud_identity.notes: Threat Research (author Yahav Festinger). After compromising a cloud environment and obtaining delete permissions, an attacker can delete a target storage bucket and immediately recreate one with the same name in their own account, redirecting the victim's data stream — abusing global bucket-name uniqueness across major CSPs. New cloud-exfil TTP angle (bucket hijacking / namespace squatting); mitigations: least-privilege on delete actions, AWS data-perimeter SCP / VPC-endpoint policies. No tracked actor; maps loosely to T1530 (Data from Cloud Storage Object), T1537 (Transfer Data to Cloud Account), T1074 (Data Staged). P1 — did NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate (not a P0 actor profile / anatomy / IR / active-exploitation advisory).

cloud_identity.title: Blinding the Watchmen: Abusing Cloud Logging Services for Defense Evasion and Visibility
cloud_identity.notes: GAP-WINDOW CATCH (published 2026-06-09, outside the 2026-06-22..2026-06-29 canvas window; surfaced during the Unit 42 homepage sweep and was missed by prior weekly canvases). Threat Research on attackers abusing cloud logging services (e.g., disabling/tampering CloudTrail and equivalent CSP logs) to evade detection and blind defenders. Distinct from the already-indexed defensive piece 'Novel Technique to Detect Cloud Threat Actor Operations' (tracking-threat-groups-through-cloud-logging) — this is the OFFENSIVE inverse. No tracked actor; maps to T1562 (Impair Defenses), specifically T1562.008 (Disable or Modify Cloud Logs), plus T1578 (Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure). P1 index-only: T1562.008 would be NEW MITRE technique coverage for the corpus, so it does NOT qualify for an autonomous draft stub. OPERATOR REVIEW: (1) decide whether to author a cloud-defense-evasion TTP; (2) if so, T1562.008 is a new technique enum to add to corpus MITRE coverage.

cloud_identity.title: Double Agents: Exposing Security Blind Spots in GCP Vertex AI
cloud_identity.notes: STALE GAP-WINDOW CATCH (published 2026-03-31 by Ofir Shaty, ~3 months before the 2026-06-28..2026-07-05 window; surfaced during this week's cloud-IAM sweep, never indexed by prior canvases). No tracked actor; maps loosely to T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1098 (Account Manipulation), T1530 (Data from Cloud Storage). Did NOT meet the weekly-canvas draft-stub gate (not a P0 actor profile / anatomy / IR / active-exploitation advisory; no tracked actor). OPERATOR REVIEW: decide whether to fold into a Vertex-AI / agentic-AI cloud TTP alongside the Pickle-in-the-Middle entry.

social_engineering.title: When "Hi, This Is IT" Comes Through Microsoft Teams
social_engineering.notes: GAP-WINDOW CATCH (published 2026-06-08, before the 2026-06-23..2026-06-30 canvas window; not indexed by prior weekly canvases, surfaced during this Unit 42 sweep). Insights/General hardening piece on chat-based social engineering via Microsoft Teams external chat: threat actors impersonate IT help desk from typosquatted/unmanaged M365 tenants to drive MFA approval. Stat anchor: collaboration-tool phishing rose to 42% of Cortex phishing alerts in first 4 months of 2026 (from 30%). Tracked actor in scope_seeds: Cloaked Ursa == APT29 == Midnight Blizzard; also references Mandiant UNC6692 (Dec 2025). Maps to T1566 (Phishing), T1656 (Impersonation), T1621 (MFA Request Generation). P1 reference — does NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate (Insights/hardening piece, not a P0 actor profile/anatomy/IR/active-exploitation advisory). OPERATOR REVIEW: decide whether to author a Teams help-desk-impersonation TTP; T1656/T1621 may be new MITRE technique coverage for the corpus.

New AI/ML supply-chain TTP angle (model-artifact deserialization + bucket squatting). No tracked actor; maps loosely to T1195 (Supply Chain Compromise), T1525 (Implant Internal Image), T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter). P1 — did NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate (not a P0 actor profile/anatomy/IR/active-exploitation advisory).

supply_chain.title: Phantom Squatting: AI-Hallucinated Domains as a Software Supply Chain Vector
supply_chain.notes: IN-WINDOW new post (published 2026-07-01T01:00Z / June 30, 6:00 PM PT; authors Keerthiraj Nagaraj, Diva-Oriane Marty, Beliz Kaleli, Oleksii Starov). Threat Research: attackers exploit LLM domain hallucinations ('phantom squatting' / slopsquatting) by pre-registering non-existent domains that LLMs repeatedly hallucinate in generated code and output, turning AI coding assistants into a software-supply-chain vector. Extends the corpus's existing AI-supply-chain cluster (ai-agent-supply-chain-risks 2026-06-11, openclaw-ai-supply-chain-risk 2026-06-23, hijacking-vertex-ai-model 2026-06-16). No tracked actor; maps loosely to T1195 (Supply Chain Compromise), T1583.001 (Acquire Infrastructure: Domains), T1608 (Stage Capabilities). P1 thematic research with a new TTP angle — does NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate (not a P0 actor profile / anatomy / IR / active-exploitation advisory; no tracked actor; T1583.001 / T1608 would be new MITRE coverage). OPERATOR REVIEW: decide whether to author an AI-supply-chain 'phantom squatting' TTP; T1583.001 / T1608 are new technique enums for the corpus if so.

detection_engineering.title: Tracing Digital Intent: New MacOS Tahoe 26 Artifact Discovered
detection_engineering.notes: New macOS Tahoe 26 forensic artifact: the App.MenuItem Biome stream (~/Library/Biome/streams/restricted/App.MenuItem/local, SEGB protobuf) logs user menu selections, reconstructing intent (Compress -> Move to Trash -> Empty Trash). Detection/IR data source for data staging (T1074), archive-collected (T1560), and indicator removal / anti-forensics (T1070). Parse with ccl-segb. No new actor/TTP -> P1 reference for macOS data-exfil detection. New 'detection_engineering' group created for detection-relevant research.

credential_attacks.title: Threat Brief: Mitigating Large-Scale Credential Attacks ("FortiBleed")
credential_attacks.notes: High Profile Threats threat brief on a large-scale password-spraying + credential-theft campaign ('FortiBleed') against internet-exposed Fortinet, Sophos, and MSSQL services; multi-stage (spray -> config/credential extraction via priv-esc -> offline cracking -> persistent admin access). An initial access broker on Russian-language forum Exploit[.]in claimed the campaign and began selling harvested credentials on 2026-06-16, referencing an unspecified CVE. Not targeting PANW devices; Unit 42 published out of an abundance of caution with hardening/MFA/ZTNA guidance. Maps to T1110 / T1110.003 (Brute Force / Password Spraying), T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1003 (credential extraction from device config). P0 active-exploitation advisory, but does NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate: the threat actor is an unnamed IAB not in scope_seeds.actors. OPERATOR REVIEW: (1) decide whether to add an actor/cluster label once Unit 42 names it; (2) confirm whether T1110 password-spraying warrants new MITRE technique coverage in the corpus.

vulnerabilities.title: Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257
vulnerabilities.notes: GAP-WINDOW CATCH (published 2026-06-05, before the 2026-06-23..2026-06-30 canvas window; not indexed by prior weekly canvases, surfaced during this Unit 42 sweep). P0 active-exploitation advisory: Unit 42 observed in-the-wild exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257, an authentication bypass in the GlobalProtect portal/gateway allowing unauthorized VPN connections; added to CISA KEV on 2026-05-29. No post-access/lateral movement observed as of publication; IOC set is IPs + spoofed host IDs/device names from PoC. New 'vulnerabilities' group created for active-exploitation advisories. Maps to T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application), T1133 (External Remote Services). Does NOT meet weekly-canvas draft-stub gate: threat actor is unidentified (not in scope_seeds.actors) and T1190/T1133 require corpus-coverage confirmation. OPERATOR REVIEW: (1) confirm whether T1190/T1133 are already in corpus MITRE coverage; (2) decide whether to author an edge-device-exploitation initial-access TTP (note: this is a PANW-product CVE — frame carefully for POV use).
